name: Halloween morning: Boop plays along when you come back
case: It's Halloween. The person left the Mac overnight and comes back at nine in the morning. Boop wakes up for them (a stretch and a yawn) and plays along with the day: a glad or mischievous face, saying something glad and hello, never a cross, sad or hurt one, and more than once.
why: The prompt's heading names the occasion (Occasions.words: Halloween); PERSONALITY: on an occasion NOW's heading names, it plays along, a gladder, bigger face than the day would get; its Example: back on Halloween, mischievous, wake up, glad then hello, twice.
